Configuration history, drafts and original-value backups in this app are kept. The idle, verified private service is stopped when leaving embedded mode; the official service is never stopped. Selection alone does not activate privileges.

Off by default. Applies saved configurations after the selected backend is ready and authorized. Does not pair, request root, start a service or change wireless debugging settings. Persistent VoLTE is not included.

Restore original values from the last operation?

This restores persistent VoLTE original values saved by the last operation. It does not replay the enable operation. Continue only after the previous operation has ended and the same SIM has been verified. Keep the app and its backups until recovery is confirmed.

Verifying current system state and permission cleanup. Wait for the result; the previous write will not be replayed.
The old task ended, but current state readback did not pass verification. Check that the target SIM is still active, then refresh. For persistent failures, review app logs in settings.
The current SIM still has original VoLTE values awaiting restoration. Verify the target, then use the restore button below.
A device reboot and the selected backend have been confirmed. Next: use the button below to confirm a read-only check of current state and archive the original record.
During verification, avoid repeating writes, clearing app data or uninstalling the app. Verification does not mean the last write succeeded.
Verify current state and resume operations
Verify and reopen operations?

Read current active SIM configuration, available persistent VoLTE status and Captive Portal settings, and confirm permission cleanup. After verification, archive the unreadable record and reopen operations. No previous write is replayed, and no original VoLTE backup is restored or deleted. The previous result remains unknown; inactive SIMs are not checked. Review IMS configuration, system network and advanced tools afterward. Automatic application remains paused.

Current state verification completed and the original record was archived. Review IMS configuration, system network and VoLTE backups. The previous result remains unknown; automatic application remains paused.
Takes effect immediately for this SIM. On compatible devices and carriers, VoLTE remains usable after a normal restart without starting a privilege service or opening TensorIMS.

This only preserves VoLTE settings. Other saved IMS configurations still need the selected backend to be ready before they can be applied again after a restart. Actual calls depend on the device, carrier and network.
